name: Hydroxyethyl Cellulose + Glycerin
indication_description: Helps lubricating in sexual intercourse specially for post menopausal women to reduce irritation, for lubrication during vaginal examinations, endoscopy, catheterization for gloves and instruments.
pharmacology_description: Hydroxyethyl Cellulose and Glycerin are colorless, odorless, non-toxic viscous liquid. Both are used in medical, pharmaceutical and personal care preparations for improving smoothness & providing lubrication.
contraindications_description: Usually well-tolerated. People with prior history of sensitivity or allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients should not use it.
precautions_description: Only for external use. When using this product do not get into eyes.
storage_conditions_description: Store in a cool & dry place, protected from light. Keep out of reach of children.
